subject: Human Body
title: Neurotransmitters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Neurotransmitters.

hook.text: Dopamine, serotonin, and GABA are chemical messengers. They cross synapses and change how you feel and think.

buildup.text: Dopamine drives reward and motivation. It surges when you anticipate something good, not just when you get it.

discovery.text: Serotonin stabilizes mood. Low serotonin is linked to depression. Most antidepressants raise its levels.

twist.text: GABA is the brain's brake pedal. Without enough of it, neurons fire too much and anxiety skyrockets.

climax.text: Every emotion is chemistry. Happiness, fear, love: they're all patterns of neurotransmitters at synapses.

punchline.text: Joy, fear, and love are chemistry in tiny gaps.

quiz.question: What role does GABA play in the brain?
options: It inhibits neural activity, acting as a brake
It converts short-term to long-term memory
